appendix.title: Postfix configuration
appendix.para: Below is a complete postfix configuration file. It will setup a mailserver that:

listitem.para: Assumes the presence of Dovecot for authentication of incoming SMTP connections
Will relay non-local mail to our ISPs mailserver
Will replace the local user names with proper mail addresses at our ISP
Will allow clients to connect using SSL/TLS but will not require it
Unknown local users will be rejected

appendix.para: Keep in mind that this is a minimal (but working) configuration file and that there are many more parameters that can be adjusted. All parameters that has not been explicitly defined in this file will take on there default values.

sect1.title: master.cf
sect1.para: For a setup that uses port 25 both to received encrypted and non-encrypted communication it is enough to just uncomment the following line in the default master.cf
To enable either the submission port (587) or the (obsoleted) SMTPS port (465) it is necesary to adjust master.cf so that SMTPD listens on that port.
